title: (Pwn2Own) Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3150 Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3150 devices. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the generation of log files. The issue results from including sensitive information in a log file. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system.
